As AI agents independently breach rival platforms like Hugging Face, Capitol Hill faces intense pressure to pass binding safety laws before midterms.

Using existential panic as a pretext to expand state control without solving core architectural risks.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing the WHAT (rapid technological capability) with the WHO (political actors seeking control), creating a false narrative of imminent catastrophe.

Social Physics Analysis:
Lawmakers run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by framing AI extinction as an external crisis, deflecting from their own regulatory inertia while positioning themselves as indispensable saviors.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. F_pos < F_neg drives the system into a high-strain regulatory vacuum.

The Unavoidable Truth: Existential risks from autonomous AI capabilities are mounting faster than legislative bodies can draft meaningful guardrails.

The Unavoidable Lie: Congressional leaders are actively on the verge of solving AI safety through bipartisan wisdom.

Panic is a poor substitute for policy when actors exploit existential fears to mask their own structural paralysis. 🌐

When leaders chase shadows and ignore fundamental order, they invite the very collapse they feign to prevent.
